title: Past perfect continuous (I had been doing)
titleId: Sudah berlangsung sebelum titik di masa lalu

cards.text: Past perfect continuous: had been + -ing. Untuk kegiatan yang berlangsung sebelum suatu titik di masa lalu, sering hasilnya masih terlihat saat itu.

examples.en: The road was wet. It had been raining.
Tom was tired. He'd been working all day.

cards.text: Juga untuk lamanya kegiatan sampai sesuatu terjadi di masa lalu.

examples.en: We'd been playing for an hour when the lights went out.
examples.id: Kami sudah bermain satu jam ketika lampu padam.

cards.text: Bandingkan: has been -ing (sampai sekarang), had been -ing (sampai titik di masa lalu), was -ing (sedang berlangsung saat itu).

examples.en: The bus finally came. I'd been waiting for 20 minutes.
examples.id: Akhirnya bus datang. Saya sudah menunggu 20 menit.

cards.trap: Kata kerja keadaan tetap tidak memakai -ing: We had known each other for years.

questions.why: Ceritanya di masa lalu dan hasil kegiatan terlihat saat itu, jadi had been crying.

questions.prompt: We ___ (walk) for two hours when we finally found a cafe.
questions.why: Lama kegiatan sampai titik di masa lalu memakai had been + -ing.

questions.prompt: I was tired because I have been working all day.
questions.answer: I was tired because I had been working all day.
questions.why: Ceritanya di masa lalu (was tired), jadi pakai had been + -ing.

questions.prompt: When I arrived, Andi was angry. He had ___ waiting for an hour.
Susun pertanyaan: "Sudah berapa lama kamu menunggu ketika bus datang?"
questions.answer: How long had you been waiting when the bus came?
questions.why: Lama kegiatan sampai titik di masa lalu: How long had you been + -ing.

questions.prompt: We were good friends. We ___ (know) each other for years.
questions.why: know adalah kata kerja keadaan, jadi past perfect simple: had known.

questions.answer: The ground was wet because it had been raining
accept: The ground was wet because it had been raining before
The ground was wet because it had been raining earlier
questions.why: Hujan berlangsung sebelum titik di masa lalu dan hasilnya terlihat, jadi had been raining.

pairs: The man was out of breath.
They'd been playing outside all day.
questions.why: Setiap penjelasan memakai had been -ing untuk kegiatan yang berlangsung sebelum titik di masa lalu.

questions.prompt: When I looked outside, it ___, but the streets were still wet.
questions.why: Saat itu hujan tidak sedang turun (was -ing). Jalan yang basah menunjukkan tadinya hujan.

questions.prompt: I had been waiting for 20 minutes when the bus came.
questions.answer: I had been waiting for 20 minutes when the bus came.
questions.why: Kalimat ini sudah benar: lamanya menunggu sampai bus datang memakai had been + -ing.
